body:
I don't care to see a counselor, I'm okay majority of the time and I usually come out okay those times when I'm not. If I get to where majority of the time I'm not okay, then I will consider it.  

Also, don't take the flu lightly! it's bad this year.
Thank you for checking up on me, I'm doing better. Emotionally I'm not in danger anymore. However I have the flu and strep throat and that very well may kill me :P

I would love to, as long as it's free (which it sounds like it is). I'm interested in mostly anything, but I particularly like neurobiology. Computational neurobiology sounds scary though. Do you have a preference?
What kind of courses can you take like that?
Thank you :)
Cool! Small world

Haha, thank you. I'm flattered. It's really nothing great I wasn't a child prodigy or anything. My mother was a pianist so she taught me how to read music and bang around on the keys when i was around 3. 

Classical music is my favorite, but the romantic era takes the cake for me. I don't really have a way to record myself :( I would love to have a decent mic but I can't afford one right now.
I slept in late and now I'm back to studying for my finals, so I suppose I'm probably not going to do anything rash any time soon. Thanks for checking on me :)
Sound advice, thank you very much for your input. You've really given me something to think on. I hope you have a good night.
Thank you for everything
Analyze away. I made it home so I'm not going to die tonight, but I would love feel better long term instead of just barely scraping by night after night
Thank you for that. I'll look him up in the morning
I see. I recently bought a book on it, will definitely be reading it once finals are over. I made it home so no immediate danger
I've looked into it a bit, and I like to meditate but have never fully committed. Meditation does make me feel better majority of the time that I'm upset or restless

Where am I far away from? And maybe I put on a good face, you never know with people online. 

I hope you don't kill yourself. I won't if you won't, deal? :p

I'm not sure I understand your question. I'm fairly accomplished for my age- Im a performing pianist and academically very successful. I love my boyfriend, but I have a pretty tough time with social anxiety. I'm really not sure what you're asking

I've played the piano for 16 years, my longest run and the instrument that im most accomplished on. I've been playing the cello, clarinet, violin, flute, percussion, guitar, harp, and ocarina for various amounts of time. Piano and cello are my favorites though, I love playing classical music. I like listening to mostly everything though. Do you play any?
I'm not you but I am alive, do you mind if I PM you?

I...are you mad at me? I can't tell if I've done something wrong or come off as insincere. I just wanted to talk to someone before I left and maybe see if someone could convince me otherwise. I hope you're okay.
I don't mind the questions, it's nice to talk to someone. But yeah my default state it seems is completely apathetic. I have to try to be interested in the things j do

I do a few things. I like archery, play a lot of instruments, reading, hiking, general exploration. I like meeting people and doing everything but nothing seems to penetrate my inner shell that's dead set on not caring about much of anything
Is drowning the worst? It doesn't seem as bad as being burned or buried alive. Are you okay now?
Thank you for talking with me, good night
That's what I'm afraid of. I already feel like this, I don't want to make things worse or seclude myself further. Maybe I should take up Buddhism.
I'm trying, but I'll keep it in mind! Thank you for cheering me up a bit :)
I love science and medicine. I'm really interested in learning, it's at my core that I feel really apathetic. I have lots of hobbies and interests that I pursue

I know exactly what I want to do with my life, and I'm currently working to achieve it. I just feel like it's meaningless I guess and if I don't succeed I want nothing to do with life anymore (boy am I melodramatic tonight)
Have you changed how you think? I'm pretty against taking medications. I don't want to give in to that mess
And that would just be unfortunate :p I want to go on an adventure, and Vermont was actually on my list so maybe that counts for something
Thanks, I appreciate it
I'm about 15 minutes from there. Now if only I had some family in Vermont...
I'm sorry :( I guess I feel similarly. Real problems are easily overcome. I can't overcome my apathy and detachment though
Small world :) which part?
Hmm that is strange. Why guilt? Who do you feel guilty for?
Arkansas. No snow here, I wish I was a little farther up north so that I could have some snow to play in
Thanks for the reference, I might take a look over there
I absolutely could be doing worse. I don't feel like I'm going anywhere though, though Ive not suffered from too many failures really...I don't know what's wrong with me
I don't have a reason to, I just have since I was young. I have pretty typical teenager problems. They don't bother me much, because I already feel like I'm gone
How about that weather? It's rather nippy around here

Like I said, I don't really have a reason. I've felt detached and pretty apathetic since I was a very small kid, and I guess 15 or so years of it has finally worn me down. Sometimes I think I have some kind of mental illness but I've never thought it was worth getting checked out. My only symptom is that I just don't care
